title: Unify Toolbar Element Visual Consistency
description: Analyze and fix all visual inconsistencies across toolbar elements in the sketchpad. Key issues: 1) Icon sizes differ between groups (some use size-tiny, others rely on addIconSize default size-small), 2) Some toolbar content uses ToolbarGroup wrapper while others use raw divs with different gap/padding, 3) getToolbarGroupIcon uses hardcoded size={16} instead of design tokens, 4) Mixed use of Button vs Toggle without consistent sizing.
summary:
Fixed the remaining toolbar inconsistency caused by an invalid CSS selector for the settings zone.

Root cause:
- Selector used `#semio.sketchpad.toolbar.zone.settings`, but the actual ID contains dots.
- In CSS, dots in an ID selector are interpreted as class separators unless escaped.
- Result: settings-zone-specific normalization for toggle `data-state=on` never applied.

Fix:
- Replaced selector with exact ID attribute selector:
  - `[id="semio.sketchpad.toolbar.zone.settings"] [data-slot="toggle-group-item"][data-state="on"]`
  - same for `:hover`

Outcome:
- Settings controls (e.g., Filter Connectors/Models and Selection Additive/Subtractive) now share the same neutral style contract across groups.
- Tools-zone active group highlighting remains unchanged.

Validation:
- `npx tsc --noEmit --project semio/sketchpad/tsconfig.json` passed.
- `npm test --workspace elements/ui` passed (23/23).
- No linter errors in changed CSS file.
